new_result.summary: For a full-column physical cross block M and arbitrary signed rank-one update M+theta a b^T, the exact Gram determinant ratio is (1+theta q)^2+theta^2 r, where q=b^T M^dagger a and r=||(I-MM^dagger)a||^2 b^T(M^TM)^{-1}b. Its amplitude/sign-uniform minimum is r/(q^2+r), so a transverse physical component repairs exact scalar resonance. Iterating gives exact multiplicative factors for arbitrary signed spectral packets; arbitrary small signed spectrum with ||E_low||<=h costs only h by physical-block Weyl.
key_equations: det((M+theta a b^T)^T(M+theta a b^T))=det(M^TM)[(1+theta q)^2+theta^2 r]
det(M_R^TM_R)=det(M_0^TM_0) product_j F_j for sequential spectral modes

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: For the final six-mode family, s6(A[I,H])>=g=sqrt(2)-1/4, hence lambda6((A^2)[H,H])>=g^2 and s3(A)>=g>1. Plugging m=6,N=15,s=g into the partner theorem gives ||p_Q||_(infinity,ess)<1097.

unresolved_implication: From only s3(A)>=1, force aggregate repaired original-coordinate cross volume or route failure quantitatively into an already-paid diffuse-bank/grouped-hub/pair/Schur/half-Riesz mechanism; naive one-good-minor and fixed-cross-rank dichotomies are refuted.
